in_marathi.name: Parmod
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Parmod हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Parmod is derived from Parma (Supreme) and Dev (God). This name signifies the one who is the lord of the universe, the supreme being. In Hindu mythology, Parmod is an epithet for various deities, including Lord Shiva and Lord Vishnu.
